'''Fish soup bee hoon''', also known as '''fish head bee hoon''', is a [[Singaporean cuisine|Singaporean]] soup-based seafood dish served hot usually with [[bee hoon]]. The dish is viewed as a healthy food by [[Singaporeans]].<ref name="Phoon 1"/> Catherine Ling of ''[[CNN]]'' listed fish soup bee hoon as one of the "40 Singapore foods we can't live without".
